CookieConsent.title: Cookie notice
CookieConsent.body: We use a few essential cookies to keep you signed in — those aren't affected by this choice. Accepting also turns on privacy-focused, cookie-free analytics and performance monitoring so we can see how the site is used and how fast it runs. Read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

PanelPlanner.help: One panel per line, or split them with “then”, commas, or full stops. Use the English words “wide”, “tall / skinny”, “big / splash”, or “beat / silent” to shape each panel.
PanelPlanner.emptyHint: Type a few panels above to see the page take shape.

comic.title: Comic Panel Planner
comic.lead: Describe your page in plain words — “wide panel for the vault, tall skinny panel for the drop, then a beat panel before the punch.” Get a rough page layout back, panel by panel.
comic.reading: A regular grid — even tiers, straight gutters, left to right, top to bottom.

manga.title: Manga Panel Planner
manga.lead: Manga pages break the grid — slanted cuts, tight column gutters, and the big beats bleeding past the frame. Describe your page and get that layout back, read right to left.
manga.reading: Right to left, top to bottom. Diagonal cuts between panels; splash and big beats bleed the frame.
